  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de bots para Discord e/ou Telegram
  • Conhecimento em human-in-the-loop design para sistemas de IA

Infraestrutura

  • Experiência prática com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Conhecimento em servidores Linux e deploy de aplicações em produção
  • Boas práticas de versionamento (Git) e segurança em aplicações web
  • Experiência com dashboards e monitoramento em tempo real

Diferenciais

Ser gamer e jogar regularmente online

title: Principal SQL Server Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal SQL Server Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,500 - $7,000 USD


Along with our partner, we’re looking for a Principal Database Engineer who can serve as the technical leader for our SQL Server–focused engineering team. This person should be the team’s strongest expert in SQL Server development, performance engineering, and operational reliability — and equally strong in designing

data‐centric solutions that balance correctness, performance, maintainability, and business constraints.


The ideal candidate brings deep, hands‐on mastery of SQL Server internals and can connect engine

behavior to real‐world workload patterns. They should be able to diagnose, design, enhance, and

optimize database solutions at scale, and guide others in doing the same.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are

well‐understood, technically feasible, and aligned with long‐term architectural goals.


Essential Duties:

  • Database Design and Development: Guide the evolution and improvement of database architecture, design and implementations. Apply expert‐level understanding of relational modeling, T‐SQL, indexing strategies, and SQL Server engine behavior to build systems that scale and perform under real‐world workloads.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Continuously assess system performance at both the instance and query level. Diagnose and remediate issues, including those involving poor execution plans, parameter sniffing, bad cardinality estimation, SARGability obstacles, inadequate or incorrect indexing, and concurrency issues involving locking, blocking, and/or deadlocks.
  • Engineering Solution Design: Break down complex data and workload problems, identify multiple viable solution paths, and evaluate them against functional and non‐functional requirements. Clearly articulate tradeoffs, recommend, and justify the best approach.
  • Collaboration with Development Teams: Partner closely with application and service teams to ensure database designs support application behavior, performance goals, and operational constraints. Provide guidance on query patterns, schema usage, and integration with .NET and cloud services.
  • Incident Management: Lead the response to database‐related incidents. Perform root‐cause analysis, implement durable fixes, and improve observability, alerting, and operational readiness.
  • Mentorship and Training: Coach and mentor database engineers and developers. Establish and promote best practices in SQL development, performance tuning, and operational excellence.
  • Data Security Management: Contribute to the implementation and enforcement of security controls, ensuring protection of sensitive data and compliance with relevant standards.
  • Backup, Recovery, and Reliability Engineering: Contribute to the design and management of resilient backup, restore, and disaster‐recovery processes. Help ensure systems are prepared for failure scenarios and can recover predictably.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 10+ years in database engineering, data management, or database administration, with significant hands‐on experience in SQL Server.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Deep expertise in SQL Server development, performance tuning, and engine internals.
  • Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, statistics, concurrency, and workload behavior.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including managed SQL services and related data technologies.
  • Proficiency in T‐SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET services is a plus.


Key Competencies:

  • Database Design and Architecture: Ability to design scalable, efficient SQL Server solutions in cloud environments, with strong judgment around schema design, indexing, and workload patterns.
  • Performance Tuning and Optimization: Expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance issues at all layers of the SQL Server stack.
  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with cloud‐based database services (Azure SQL, Managed Instance, AWS RDS, etc.) and understanding of how cloud infrastructure impacts database design and performance.
  • Programming and Engineering Skills: Strong T‐SQL development skills and familiarity with the broader SQL Server ecosystem. Ability to reason about system‐level design and integrate database solutions with application architectures.
  • Data Management and Security: Ensure data integrity, enforce security controls, and resolve data‐related issues with precision and accountability.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and communicate clearly with cross‐functional partners. Influence architectural direction and foster a culture of engineering excellence.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and optimize large-scale data systems that power critical business operations.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm headquartered in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Software Engineer with strong .NET and Azure expertise and hands-on experience building AI-powered engineering workflows.

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.


About the Role

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

This is an international environment, and the position is collaborative and technically strong.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for .NET applications
  • Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms
  • Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated .NET code and pull requests
  • Develop automation around Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling
  • Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns
  • Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic
  • Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework
  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation
  • Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design
  • Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation
  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
  • Observability or evaluation frameworks for AI systems
  • Experience with Blazor or legacy .NET Framework applications
  • Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;
  • are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies;
  • can balance engineering quality with experimentation;
  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .Net Pleno #1003870

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. • Docker

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Backend Engineer

Hitch — Remote


About Hitch

Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.


We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance.
  • Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job.
  • Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code.
  • Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring.
  • Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews.
  • Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior.
  • Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent).
  • A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation.
  • Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask \"what happens if this fails halfway through?\"
  • Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns.
  • Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical.
  • Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms.
  • Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role).
  • Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.

    • Our Backend Stack

    TypeScript · Node.js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Workday Financials Consultant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the job


As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment.

What you’ll do


  • Provide hands-on configuration, support, and maintenance across multiple Workday Financials domains.
  • Act as a flexible “utility player,” supporting priority areas based on business needs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and system defects in a timely manner.
  • Design and implement scalable Workday Financials solutions aligned with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into system configurations.
  • Support ongoing enhancements, optimizations, and process improvements within Workday Financials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of financial system changes.
  • Contribute to backlog reduction and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with best practices.


What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills.
  • Proven experience across multiple Financials domains, especially: Financial Accounting (top priority), Expenses, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement (secondary)
  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Workday integrations and reporting is a plus.
  • Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

Job Overview:

We are a residential cleaning company based in California, USA, with a warm and collaborative team environment. This is a long-term role for someone who would enjoy working closely with a small, hands-on business rather than a large corporate environment.

We’re a small, professional, and friendly team, and we’re looking for someone reliable, attentive, organized, and committed to long-term, consistent work. 

To apply:

If this sounds like the right fit for you, please send your resume, along with a 1 to 2 minute video in English sharing a bit about your professional experience, to

Please also include which schedule option you prefer.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Artwork Controller
description:

Artwork Controller

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Type: Contract Role


We are hiring Artwork Controller to support and manage the end-to-end packaging and labeling artwork process within a global regulated environment. This role requires strong coordination across multiple stakeholders and ensures delivery of high-quality, compliant, and timely artwork across regional markets.


Role Overview

The role involves managing the complete artwork lifecycle—from initial brief creation to final approval and release. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Quality, Marketing, Supply Chain, and external vendors/printers to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.

You will also play a key role in driving process improvements, supporting system enhancements, and ensuring operational excellence in artwork and labeling workflows.


Key Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end artwork development process (brief to final release)

Ensure all packaging and labeling artwork meets global regulatory and quality standards

Act as a key liaison between internal teams and external vendors/agencies

Validate project briefs and resolve gaps or discrepancies with stakeholders

Manage multiple concurrent projects with strict timelines

Coordinate review and approval workflows in PLM/electronic systems

Support RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and implement CAPA actions

Maintain issue logs and support escalation management

Participate in content lock and alignment meetings

Ensure design-to-print feasibility (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed, etc.)

Track project progress, risks, and key milestones

Support process improvement and digital tool optimization initiatives

Provide training and guidance to junior team members when required

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Packaging Technology, or related field

10+ years of experience in artwork / labeling / packaging / regulatory / proofreading roles

Strong experience in pharma / medical devices / consumer health industry

Hands-on experience with PLM systems (Agile, Veeva, Loftware, GLAMS, Veraciti, etc.)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro)

Strong understanding of pre-press and print processes (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed)

Experience with proofreading tools (GlobalVision, TVT, InformCC)

Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder handling skills

title: Acquisition Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Acquisition Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .Net Pleno #1003870
description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor .Net PL para se juntar à nossa equipe de Infraestrutura. O projeto consiste no desenvolvimento de uma nova plataforma que conterá algumas API's, Processadores e um Portal. Este sistema deverá ser construído utilizando as tecnologias .NET 6 e ReactJS.


O que você precisa ter?

• Microserviços

• C#, Asp.Net, .Net Architecture

• Web services

• SQL server

• HTML

• Javascript

• Docker

• Kubernets


Desejável:

• DHTML, Web design, XSLT

• Visual Basic, Crystal Reports

• Conhecimento/Experiência em UML, ênfase em especificação de caso e técnicas de realização de caso de uso.

• Conhecimento/Experiência em Processos RUP.

• Conhecimento da indústria financeira.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

• Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação sistemas e aplicações de acordo com a tecnologia definida, desenvolvendo conforme os padrões de arquitetura de software, gerando códigos limpos, organizados e bem testados.

• Trabalhará em um modelo de desenvolvimento ágil, com um time multidisciplinar, em um ambiente agradável, colaborativo e profissional.

• Participará de todas as cerimônias do processo desde planejamento das releases, ajudando a identificar valor ao negócio, até sua entrega e implantação do sistema.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

Submit your resume and a short introduction explaining why you are a good fit for a detail-focused, people-oriented role.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor .Net SR para se juntar à nossa equipe de Infraestrutura. O(a) candidato(a) ideal é alguém com experiência na função. Além disso, buscamos alguém que tenha um forte desejo de aprender e trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe.

O projeto consiste no desenvolvimento de uma nova plataforma que conterá algumas API's, Processadores e um Portal. Este sistema deverá ser construído utilizando as tecnologias .NET 6 e ReactJS.


Responsabilidades:

Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação sistemas e aplicações de acordo com a tecnologia definida, desenvolvendo conforme os padrões de arquitetura de software, gerando códigos limpos, organizados e bem testados.   • .Net Architecture
  • Web services
  • SQL server
  • HTML
  • Javascript
  • Docker
  • Kubernets

  • XSLT
  • Visual Basic

  • Conhecimento/Experiência em UML, ênfase em especificação de caso e técnicas de realização de caso de uso.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

description:

Digital Content Creator (Video)

100% remote / PJ


>>> Only resumes in english <<<


We are looking for a Digital Content Creator (Video) to scale Datavations’ visual storytelling without losing the craft that makes it land. The system already exists. The presentations are sharp, the data is differentiated, the marketing engine is producing. What we need is the right person to convert that work into video at the pace our team and LinkedIn audience expects.

- Strong proficiency in Canva, at least one professional editing suite (Adobe, CapCut, Final Cut, or DaVinci), and Google Slides or PowerPoint;

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Risk & Governance Analyst - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk & Governance Analyst - Remote Work em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Risk & Governance Analyst position involves establishing and overseeing the IT governance framework to mitigate operational risks and ensure regulatory compliance, providing strategic metrics that facilitate informed decision-making by senior management. As the strategic architect behind technology's safety and compliance, your mission is to bridge the gap between complex technical operations and business objectives by identifying potential threats before they materialize. You'll build a culture of risk awareness, ensuring IT infrastructure remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with international standards like ISO 27001 and COBIT.


Key responsibilities


- Coordinating information security risk assessment and reassessment activities.

- Following up with risk owners and business areas to obtain status updates and evidence.

- Consolidating, measuring, and communicating monthly KPIs for IT teams.

- Ensuring that periodic reviews include open, in-progress, and closed risks.

- Supporting risk reporting and governance communication to management.


Requirements


- Risk Analysis: 2+ years of professional experience in risk analysis.

- ISO Knowledge: Foundation knowledge of ISO 31000.

- Analytical Background: Background in risk and data analysis.

- Office Suite: Proficiency in Google Office or Microsoft Office.

- Operating Systems: Experience with Windows 10 or superior.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;

  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;

What makes us different?

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
  • SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
  • Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements:

  • Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
  • SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
  • Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).

title: Senior AWS DevSecOps Engineer (Security & Compliance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AWS DevSecOps Engineer (Security & Compliance) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?

We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Senior DevSecOps Engineer .

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior AWS DevSecOps Engineer who is passionate about building secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and committed to excellence in security-first environments.

This role is strictly focused on hands-on AWS DevSecOps experience in regulated environments such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, NIST, or similar . We are looking for someone who has directly built, secured, and supported cloud infrastructure in production environments — not someone with only general DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure experience.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AWS security tooling , compliance and audit support , security-by-default infrastructure , encryption and key management , and CI/CD pipelines with embedded security controls .

The salary range is $4,000 USD to $5,000 USD per month , depending on the candidate's experience and seniority.

Candidates from other Latin American countries may be considered. Candidates in a time zone outside of the Western Hemisphere will NOT be considered. The role is 100% remote .

ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:
  • Design, build, and maintain secure-by-default AWS infrastructure in regulated environments.
  • Implement and manage AWS security and infrastructure services such as IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF, Secrets Manager, VPC, RDS, S3, and Lambda .
  • Configure and enforce IAM least-privilege access policies across services, users, workloads, and environments.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines with security controls , including SAST, dependency scanning, secrets detection, and security gates .
  • Implement encryption and key management strategies for data at rest and in transit, including KMS, TLS, key rotation, certificate lifecycle management, and secrets handling .
  • Set up and monitor security logging, auditing, alerting, and threat detection systems .
  • Support compliance and regulatory initiatives including HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, NIST, or similar frameworks , including audit preparation, documentation, remediation, and control implementation .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure secure architecture and cloud security best practices.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation .
  • Support security incidents, risk mitigation efforts, remediation plans, and infrastructure security decisions .


Requirements:
  • 3+ years of hands-on AWS DevSecOps experience with a strong security-first mindset.
  • Proven experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments , such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, NIST, or equivalent .
  • Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security tooling, including:
  • IAM
  • KMS
  • GuardDuty
  • Security Hub
  • CloudTrail
  • WAF
  • Secrets Manager
  • Experience implementing security-by-default infrastructure and DevSecOps best practices in production.
  • Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines with embedded security controls .
  • Strong understanding of encryption standards and key management , including TLS, AES-256, KMS, certificate lifecycle, and secure secrets management .
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation .
  • Experience supporting audit readiness, remediation efforts, or compliance control implementation .
  • Experience with AWS IoT Core , or strong AWS experience with the ability to support secure IoT architectures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive and ownership-driven mindset.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused.
  • Fluent in English. YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH.


Preferred:
  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer
  • Direct experience implementing HIPAA technical safeguards
  • Experience supporting incident response , audit processes, or cloud security remediation


Important Note for Applicants:

This role requires that the candidate’s resume clearly reflect hands-on experience with:

  • AWS security tooling
  • regulated/compliance environments
  • security controls in CI/CD
  • encryption and key management
  • DevSecOps in production

Profiles that are primarily centered on general DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, or CI/CD without clear evidence of security tooling and compliance work may not be considered for this opportunity.


Engagement Structure & Duration:

This is a long-term contract opportunity structured in phases over a 24-month period .

Phase 1 (Initial Build Phase):

Months 1–3: 40 hours per week (full-time)

Months 4–6: 30 hours per week (reduced workload)

Phase 2 (Maintenance & Monitoring):

Months 7–24: ~5 hours per week (ongoing support and monitoring)

This structure reflects an initial intensive infrastructure build phase followed by a lighter, steady-state maintenance period.


Compensation Structure:

Compensation will be handled on a monthly salary basis, adjusted according to the expected workload and hours per phase.

While the role is paid monthly, compensation will reflect the number of hours worked in each phase (full-time, reduced hours, and maintenance phase).

This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in high-ownership environments and enjoy building secure systems from the ground up.

Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico- Bash scripting em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Visão Geral do Projeto

Estamos desenvolvendo um sistema de gerenciamento de tradução para Text-to-Speech (TTS) voltado a anúncios utilizados em produtos da TK Elevator. O projeto tem foco na automação da geração de áudio, gerenciamento de traduções e garantia da implantação de alta qualidade de arquivos de áudio multilíngues.

Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Desenvolvedor hands-on com experiência como Scrum Master ou Team Lead para apoiar tanto o desenvolvimento técnico quanto a coordenação do projeto. Esta função combina engenharia de software, automação e facilitação de equipes para garantir entregas eficientes e melhoria contínua.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Interagir diretamente com stakeholders de negócio
  • Gerenciar a geração e o ciclo de vida de anúncios de áudio
  • Coordenar com tradutores para notificar quando os arquivos de áudio estiverem disponíveis
  • Apoiar tradutores na revisão e correção de áudios quando necessário
  • Garantir a implantação adequada dos arquivos de áudio finalizados
  • Manter e organizar os arquivos de áudio para facilitar acesso e revisão
  • Realizar deploy de arquivos de áudio em ambientes cloud e coordenar implantações com fornecedores externos
  • Desenvolver e manter scripts e ferramentas para geração e empacotamento de áudio
  • Gerenciar e manter dois repositórios Git:
  • repositório de arquivos de áudio
  • repositório de ferramentas e geração de pacotes
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI para automação e deploy
  • Facilitar cerimônias Agile/Scrum, remover impedimentos e garantir a produtividade da equipe

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Inglês fluente

  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor de Software com responsabilidades de Team Lead ou Scrum Master
  • Forte experiência com:
  • Bash scripting
  • Ambientes Linux
  • Git (controle de versão e gerenciamento de repositórios)
  • Experiência com automação, gerenciamento de arquivos e fluxos de deploy

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistemas Text-to-Speech (TTS) ou processamento de áudio
  • Python
  • Pipelines de CI (automação e deploy)
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud
  • Experiência com fluxos de tradução/localização
  • Capacidade de atuar apoiando outros times/projetos fora do programa principal de TTS como Scrum Master ágil, quando houver disponibilidade

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
  • SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
  • Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements:

  • Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
  • SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
  • Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements:

  • Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"\"noisy\"\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
  • Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Brazil) (Must align with US PST Time Zone)

Advanced English

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;

Job: Social Media Manager / Content Creator (Part-Time)


Work Schedule: 20 hours/week (4 hours/day) during US business hours.


Role Overview: Our client is a US-based insurance consulting platform that helps CFOs and businesses reduce costs and optimize insurance, employee benefits, and retirement plans through independent market analysis.


They are looking for a creative and experienced Social Media Manager / Content Creator to help manage and grow their online presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.   • Create and edit short-form video content for social media

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple content deadlines
  • Strong English communication and organizational skills
  • Experience working with B2B companies or professional service firms is a plus


English: C1 or C2 preferred

With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.

Experience
